summary: Markets are pricing in roughly a 63% chance of a Fed rate hike in September, keeping bond duration under pressure and real rates elevated. Geopolitical tensions remained elevated after the US military launched fresh strikes on Iranian targets in retaliation for Tehran's attacks on US assets across the Middle East, sustaining an energy risk premium that is weighing on gold's safe-haven appeal even as stocks hold up on low volatility.
tweet: A ~63% market-implied chance of a September Fed hike collides with fresh US strikes on Iran — bonds and gold rattled, stocks surprisingly resilient.
